info.title: FoxInsights
info.description: Bring FoxInsights tank data into your flows and business apps. Get devices, fill levels and the latest readings, trigger orders or alerts when a tank runs low, and keep partners, customers, products and tank settings in sync with your ERP or CRM.

get.description: Returns the partner that owns the connection credentials together with all of its sub-partners as a nested tree. Use 'List partners' to loop over partners in a flow.

post.description: Creates a sub-partner. Not safe to retry: a repeated call creates a second partner.

get.description: Returns the partner that owns the connection credentials and all of its sub-partners as a flat list, ready for 'Apply to each'.
Returns the devices that belong directly to one partner, with their current fill level and latest measurement. Devices of sub-partners are not included.

parameters.name: partnerId
parameters.description: Partner whose own devices are returned.

get.description: Returns one device by its hardware ID, with its current fill level and latest measurement.

parameters.name: hwid
parameters.description: Hardware ID of the device, printed on the sensor.

get.description: Returns the devices with the given partner-specific internal ID.

parameters.name: internalId
parameters.description: Partner's own ID for the device.

get.description: Returns the devices whose address company matches the given name.

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Company name in the device address.

get.description: Returns whether the device contract is cancelled or marked for cancellation and from when it can be cancelled.
Returns the devices assigned to one end customer, with their current fill level and latest measurement.

put.description: Assigns a device to an end customer.

delete.description: Removes a device from an end customer. Without Keep device settings, the device address and tank settings are deleted.

get.description: Returns one partner with its internal ID, products and notification e-mail addresses.
Returns the partners with the given internal ID.

put.description: Replaces all fields of an end customer; fields left empty are cleared.

get.description: Returns the end customers with the given internal ID.

parameters.name: internalId
parameters.description: Internal ID of the end customer.

get.description: Returns the end customers whose custom field has the given value.
Returns the end customer with the given e-mail address.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: E-mail address of the end customer.

get.description: Returns the products with the given product code.
Returns all product types with their default settings.
Returns the catalogue tank types available for a product.

put.description: Replaces the device name, internal ID and partner notes.
Replaces all labels of the device with the given list; labels not in the list are removed.
Sets the fill levels at which the info and alert notifications are sent.
Locks or unlocks the device configuration for end customers.
Moves the device to another partner within the accessible partner tree.
Marks the device contract for cancellation on the given date.
Changes the product stored in the device's tank or silo.
Configures the device for a tank described by its dimensions; replaces any previous tank or silo configuration.
Configures the device for a catalogue tank type (see 'Get predefined tank types'); replaces any previous tank or silo configuration.
Configures the device for a silo; replaces any previous tank or silo configuration.

delete.description: Removes the tank or silo configuration of the device; fill levels are not computed until a new configuration is set.

put.description: Replaces the list of e-mail addresses that receive partner notifications.
Replaces the list of products assigned to the partner.

post.description: Creates an end customer. Not safe to retry: a repeated call fails or creates a duplicate.
Creates a product. Not safe to retry: a repeated call creates a second product.

put.description: Replaces all fields of a product.

notificationEmails.description: E-mail addresses that receive partner notifications.

internalId.description: Partner's own ID for the end customer.

partnerId.description: ID of the partner the user belongs to.

companyPosition.description: Position in the company, e.g. MANAGEMENT, SALES, DISPATCHING.

customFields.description: Partner-defined custom fields as name/value pairs.

type.description: Product type, e.g. HEATING_OIL, DIESEL, LPG, PELLETS.

isCollecting.description: Whether the product is collected (e.g. waste oil) instead of consumed.

displayAs100Percent.description: Which capacity counts as 100 percent: USABLE_VOLUME or TOTAL_VOLUME.

partnerIds.description: Partners the product is assigned to.

meteringTime.description: Time of day of the scheduled measurement.

type.description: Product type, e.g. HEATING_OIL, DIESEL, LPG, PELLETS.

defaultDensityKgpl.description: Default density in kg per litre.

isCancelled.description: Whether the device contract is cancelled.

cancellableAfter.description: Earliest date the contract can be cancelled.

markedForCancellationOn.description: Date the contract is marked to be cancelled on.

name.description: Device name; leave empty to clear.

internalId.description: Partner's own ID for the device; empty string clears it.

partnerNotes.description: Partner notes; empty string clears them.

labels.description: Complete list of labels; replaces the current labels.

notificationInfoPercentage.description: Fill level in percent (0-100) that triggers the info notification.

notificationAlertPercentage.description: Fill level in percent (0-100) that triggers the alert notification.

isLocked.description: Yes to lock the configuration for end customers.

partnerId.description: Partner to move the device to.

offsetCm.description: Distance between sensor and tank top.

isUsableVolume.description: Yes if the volume is the usable volume, no if it is the total volume.

shape.description: VERTICAL_CYLINDER is stored as sent but reported as SQUARED.

storageTypeId.description: Catalogue tank type ID from 'Get predefined tank types'.

storageCount.description: Number of connected tanks of this type.

parentId.description: Partner under which the new partner is created.

productIds.description: Products assigned to the new partner.

notificationEmails.description: Complete list; replaces the current addresses.

productIds.description: Complete list; replaces the current products.

role.description: USER for private customers, B2B_CUSTOMER / B2B_ADMIN for business customers.

customFields.description: Custom fields as a JSON object of name/value pairs; use {} for none.

keepData.description: Yes to keep the device's address and tank settings.
Yes to keep the device's address and tank settings; default no deletes them.

imageUrl.description: Image URL; take it from 'Get product types'.

measurementInterval.description: Take the default from 'Get product types'.

safetyMargin.description: Take the default from 'Get product types'.

partnerIds.description: Partners the product is assigned to.

offlineNotification.description: Offline notification settings; leave empty for defaults.

meteringTime.description: Time of day of the scheduled measurement; leave empty for default.

children.description: Sub-partners, each with the same structure as the partner.

parentId.description: ID of the parent partner; empty for the partner that owns the credentials.

depth.description: Level in the partner tree; 0 for the partner that owns the credentials.

hwid.description: Hardware ID of the device; stable key for the device.

partnerId.description: ID of the partner the device belongs to.

internalId.description: Partner's own ID for the device; may be empty and is not guaranteed to be unique.

userId.description: ID of the end customer the device is assigned to.

hasServiceAgreement.description: Whether the end customer has a service agreement.

maintenanceState.description: Maintenance state: UNKNOWN, OK, COMPLAINED, SENT_BACK, RECEIVED, CHECKED or DEFECT.

setupAt.description: Setup time. Its unit depends on the account mode, so do not rely on it.

maxVolume.description: Legacy maximum volume in litres; use Usable quantity / Total quantity instead.

notificationInfoEnabled.description: Whether the info notification is enabled.

notificationInfoPercentage.description: Fill level in percent that triggers the info notification.

notificationAlertEnabled.description: Whether the alert notification is enabled.

notificationAlertPercentage.description: Fill level in percent that triggers the alert notification.

isLocked.description: Whether the device configuration is locked.

Metering.description: Latest reliable measurement; empty when the device has not measured yet.

measuredAt.description: Measurement time in UTC, derived from the Unix timestamp of the latest measurement.

batteryLevel.description: Battery level: FULL, GOOD, MEDIUM, WARNING or CRITICAL.

signalStrength.description: Signal strength: VERY_WEAK, WEAK, GOOD or EXCELLENT.

ComputedStorage.description: Fill level computed from the storage configuration; empty when the device has no storage configured.

percentage.description: Fill level in percent; check Measured at, a device without a measurement can report 0.

displayAs100Percent.description: Which capacity counts as 100 percent: USABLE_VOLUME or TOTAL_VOLUME.

isCollectingProduct.description: Whether the storage collects product (e.g. waste oil) instead of consuming it.

LocalDate.description: Estimated date when the storage needs a refill.

index.description: Order probability: VERY_HIGH, HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW.

hwid.name: hwid
hwid.description: Hardware ID of the device, printed on the sensor.
